source_rules.trigger: Practical pyrotechnic special effects; licensing applies to the operators of those effects.
source_rules.force: Required licenses/permits and operator licenses as applicable. No general open-flame branch.
source_rules.exceptions: Only required permits and applicable State/Federal licenses; does not identify jurisdiction-specific authorities or establish marine permits.
source_rules.remedy_detail: If practical pyrotechnic special effects are planned, obtain any required licenses and/or permits from the proper Authorities Having Jurisdiction over pyrotechnic materials before use. Use Pyrotechnic Special Effects Operators with valid State and Federal license(s), as applicable. Confirm the planned effects method and filming jurisdiction to assess which requirements apply.
source_rules.review_scope: Development wording review against the exact supplied excerpt; not independent professional review or validation of local requirements.
source_rules.additional_context_review: The longer retrieved paragraph adds controlled-use and notification guidance before the unchanged licensing clauses; it introduces no conflicting applicability exception. Reviewed against the complete saved excerpt on 2026-09-11.
source_rules.source_quote: When pyrotechnic materials are used on set, such use shall be under controlled conditions with due regard for the safety of all involved. • The Production Company or Studio shall make sufficient advanced notification of the use of pyrotechnic materials to the appropriate departments (such as Special Effects, Stunts, Camera, Art, Construction, Hair, Make-up and Wardrobe), in order to safely plan pyrotechnic special effects. Any performer who may be involved in a pyrotechnic special effect shall be notified. • Any required licenses and/or permits shall be obtained from proper Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) over pyrotechnic materials prior to using pyrotechnic special effects. Pyrotechnic Special Effects Operator(s) must hold valid State and Federal license(s), as applicable.

source_rules.trigger: Personnel working in or around water for devices; personnel IN the water for accounting, when necessary.
source_rules.force: Recommendations, with necessity qualification and example accounting methods.
source_rules.exceptions: An accounting plan is not an unconditional duty for everyone around water; buddy/check-in systems are examples, not mandatory exclusive methods.
source_rules.remedy_detail: Confirm whether personnel will work in or around water and how appropriate water safety devices will be made available. If personnel will enter the water, determine whether a personnel accounting plan is necessary and, if so, which suitable method to use (for example, a buddy or check-in/check-out system).
source_rules.review_scope: Development wording review of the complete retrieved paragraph; not independent professional review or a final production plan.
source_rules.source_quote: Appropriate water safety devices (e.g., life vests, life preservers, safety rings, safety hooks, buoys) should be available for all personnel working in or around water. When necessary, the Production Management should implement a plan to account for personnel in the water, such as a “buddy” or a check in/check out system.

citations.title: CSATF Safety Bulletin #16: Recommended Guidelines for Safety with Pyrotechnic Special Effects
citations.excerpt: When pyrotechnic materials are used on set, such use shall be under controlled conditions with due regard for the safety of all involved. • The Production Company or Studio shall make sufficient advanced notification of the use of pyrotechnic materials to the appropriate departments (such as Special Effects, Stunts, Camera, Art, Construction, Hair, Make-up and Wardrobe), in order to safely plan pyrotechnic special effects. Any performer who may be involved in a pyrotechnic special effect shall be notified. • Any required licenses and/or permits shall be obtained from proper Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) over pyrotechnic materials prior to using pyrotechnic special effects. Pyrotechnic Special Effects Operator(s) must hold valid State and Federal license(s), as applicable.

citations.title: CSATF Safety Bulletin #17: Water Hazards
citations.excerpt: Appropriate water safety devices (e.g., life vests, life preservers, safety rings, safety hooks, buoys) should be available for all personnel working in or around water. When necessary, the Production Management should implement a plan to account for personnel in the water, such as a “buddy” or a check in/check out system.

citations.excerpt: The Producer should take steps to prevent hyperthermia (elevated body temperature) and hypothermia (reduced body temperature).
